articles.body: StyleDesk bills you monthly on the anniversary of your signup date. Your invoice is emailed on each billing date and shows the plan, seat count, and any usage overage. You can view upcoming charges under Settings, Billing, Upcoming invoice.
articles.title: How billing cycles work

articles.body: Go to Settings, Billing, Payment method, then click Replace card. We accept Visa, Mastercard, and American Express. The new card is charged on your next billing date; past invoices are not re-charged.
articles.title: Update your payment method

articles.body: If your card is declined we retry the charge automatically on day 3 and day 7, and email you each time. Update the card before the third retry fails or your workspace is paused. Banks sometimes flag the charge, so check with yours first.
articles.title: Understand a failed payment

articles.body: Refunds are available within 14 days of a charge for monthly plans and 30 days for annual plans. Write to billing@styledesk.example with the invoice number. Refunds go back to the original card within 5 to 10 business days.
articles.title: Request a refund

articles.body: Open Settings, Billing, Invoices to see every invoice. Click any row to download a PDF receipt for your records. You can also set a billing email so finance gets copies automatically.
articles.title: Download invoices and receipts

articles.body: Upgrades take effect immediately and are prorated for the rest of the cycle. Downgrades take effect at the end of the current cycle so you keep what you paid for. Changing seat counts follows the same rule.
articles.title: Change your plan

articles.body: Annual plans cost 20 percent less than paying monthly for the same seats. The full year is charged up front and is refundable within the first 30 days. You can switch from monthly to annual anytime from the Billing page.
articles.title: Annual plan discount

articles.body: VAT or GST is added where required by your billing country. Add your tax ID under Settings, Billing, Tax details and it appears on every invoice. Tax-exempt organizations can upload a certificate for review.
articles.title: Taxes on your invoice

articles.body: Click Forgot password on the sign-in page and enter your work email. The reset link expires after 24 hours and can be used once. If you do not see the email, check spam and add noreply@styledesk.example to your contacts.
articles.title: Reset your password

articles.body: Go to Settings, Security, and turn on two-factor authentication. Scan the QR code with any authenticator app and enter the 6-digit code to confirm. Save the backup codes somewhere safe in case you lose your phone.
articles.title: Enable two-factor authentication

articles.body: Open Settings, Profile, and enter the new email address. We send a verification link to the new address; the change completes only after you click it. Your old address stops receiving notifications immediately.
articles.title: Change your account email

articles.body: Admins can invite people from Admin, Team, Invite. Assign a role: viewer can read tickets, agent can reply, admin can change settings. Invites expire after 7 days and can be resent from the same page.
articles.title: Invite team members

articles.body: Go to Admin, Team, click the member, and choose Remove. Their open tickets are reassigned to the queue owner and their replies stay in ticket history. The seat frees up on your next billing cycle.
articles.title: Remove a team member

articles.body: Account deletion is permanent after a 30-day grace period. Export your tickets first from Settings, Data, Export. During the grace period you can sign in to cancel the deletion and restore everything.
articles.title: Delete your account

articles.body: If Okta or Google Workspace sign-in fails, confirm with your IT admin that the StyleDesk app is assigned to you. SSO logins use your work email exactly as provisioned; personal Gmail addresses will not match an SSO-enforced workspace.
articles.title: Sign-in issues with SSO

articles.body: Admins can edit the workspace name, timezone, and logo under Admin, Workspace. The timezone controls ticket timestamps and business-hour rules, so set it to your support team's primary location.
articles.title: Update your company profile

articles.body: If the dashboard shows a blank page, hard-refresh with Ctrl Shift R or Cmd Shift R. Check status.styledesk.example for ongoing incidents. If only your account is affected, clearing site data for styledesk.example usually fixes it.
articles.title: Dashboard not loading

articles.body: First check your notification settings under Profile, Notifications, and confirm the channel is enabled. Email alerts can land in spam; add noreply@styledesk.example to your allowlist. Push notifications need the mobile app signed in.
articles.title: Notifications not arriving

articles.body: Search indexes new tickets within about 15 minutes, so very new tickets may not appear yet. Try fewer keywords or clear your filters. If old tickets are missing too, ask an admin to trigger a reindex from Admin, Search.
articles.title: Ticket search returns no results

articles.body: Attachments are limited to 25 MB per file. Allowed types are PDF, PNG, JPG, DOCX, XLSX, CSV, and TXT. If a valid file still fails, try renaming it without special characters and upload again.
articles.title: Attachments failing to upload

articles.body: Queues with more than 10,000 open tickets load slowly. Archive resolved tickets and use saved filters to narrow the view. The bulk archive tool under Queues, Bulk actions handles 500 tickets at a time.
articles.title: Slow performance on large inboxes

articles.body: Update the StyleDesk app to version 4.2 or newer, which fixed a login crash on both iOS and Android. If it still crashes, uninstall and reinstall the app, then sign in again. Your tickets sync back automatically.
articles.title: Mobile app crashes on login

articles.body: An empty export usually means the date range filter excludes all rows, or your role lacks export permission. Widen the range and ask an admin to check Reports, Permissions. Exports are capped at 100,000 rows.
articles.title: CSV export is empty

articles.body: Go to Queues, New queue, and name it for the team or topic, for example Billing or Tier 2. Assign agents and set the default priority. New tickets route to the queue whose rules match first.
articles.title: Create your first ticket queue

articles.body: Open Automations, New rule, and choose the trigger Ticket created. Add the action Send auto-reply and write the message, for example confirming receipt and the expected response time. Limit one auto-reply per ticket to avoid loops.
articles.title: Set up auto-replies

articles.body: Canned responses are saved reply snippets. Create them under Settings, Canned responses, and insert one with the # shortcut while typing a reply. Personalize the snippet before sending so customers do not feel they got a robot.
articles.title: Use canned responses

articles.body: Go to Reports, Custom, and pick metrics like tickets solved, median first response, and CSAT. Add a weekly schedule and the PDF is emailed every Monday at 8 AM in your workspace timezone. Save the report to reuse it.
articles.title: Build a weekly report

articles.body: Open Apps, Slack, and click Connect. Approve the OAuth scopes and choose the channel for ticket alerts. You can create tickets from Slack with the /styledesk command and get notified on replies.
articles.title: Connect the Slack integration

articles.body: Each queue can have its own schedule under Queues, Settings, Business hours. Add holiday exceptions so SLAs pause correctly. Tickets arriving outside hours follow the after-hours automation you configure.
articles.title: Set business hours

articles.body: Select two or more tickets in a queue, click Merge, and choose which ticket survives. All replies, attachments, and history move to the surviving ticket. Merged tickets keep the oldest creation date for SLA math.
articles.title: Merge duplicate tickets
